care.water: Water when the top 2-3 cm of soil is dry.
care.light: Bright, indirect light. Tolerates lower light but grows slowly and loses variegation.
care.feeding: Half-strength balanced fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in spring and summer.

care.water: Let the soil dry out completely between waterings (every 2-4 weeks, less in winter).
care.light: Bright, indirect light is best. Tolerates low light.
care.feeding: Light feeding 2-3 times in spring and summer only.

care.water: Water deeply only when the soil is almost completely dry. Use a cactus / succulent mix.
care.light: Bright light with some direct sun. Adjust gradually to strong sun.
care.feeding: Very little. Half-strength succulent fertilizer once or twice in summer.

care.water: Keep lightly moist, and water when the top 2-3 cm is dry. Prefers rain or filtered water.
care.feeding: Half-strength fertilizer every 4-6 weeks in spring and summer.

care.water: Keep evenly moist, and water when the top 2-3 cm is dry. It droops clearly when thirsty.
care.light: Medium to bright, indirect light. No direct sun.
care.temperature: 18-29 C. Keep away from cold drafts and AC.
care.feeding: Half-strength fertilizer every 6-8 weeks in spring and summer.
